minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  June 28, 2021

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting  ID:
960 5053 9618 Passcode: 017243 at 9:30 am.

  Members Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Jose Cortes, Human Resource
  Sabrina Barnes, Parks and Rec
  Capt. Fried, Police Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Peggy Velasquez reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of June 14, 2021, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing technical services to the Police Department in the amount of $1,956.36. Motion carried
  unanimously.

3. Katherine Leighnor – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing services of
  installing artwork in public areas at City Hall in the amount of $1,476.00. Motion carried
  unanimously.

4. Worxtime – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for compliance services to the
  Human Resources department in the amount of $1,552.48. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Peggy Velasquez reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting
adjourned at 9:45 a.m. Adjournment
